name: test-tier-boundaries
body: Every test in the repo belongs to exactly one of three tiers, defined by its body, and the layout must expose them to separate selection. **unit** — exactly one unit under test, everything else faked; pure in-memory (no filesystem, database, git or process). **int** — two or more units wired together; still pure in-memory (filesystem/database/git/process faked). **e2e** — one or more units with real I/O of any kind: any filesystem access (including `std::env::temp_dir()`/`TempDir`), opening `db.lbug`, any git operation, or any process spawn. The body wins over any name or evidence list. **Layout:** unit and int tests live in a sibling `tests.rs` of their source module, preserving the module path so libtest's `…::tests::unit::` and `…::tests::int::` filters select them. Every e2e test lives in an integration crate at its own crate's top level — `tests/<module>_e2e.rs`, where "top-level" means the top level of the crate that owns the source module, never a single repo-root `tests/` shared by all crates: the frontend crates are separate projects, so each first-party crate (the root `apg` crate and each frontend crate that carries tests) has its own `tests/` directory beside its `Cargo.toml`, holding one such file per source module plus a shared `tests/common/mod.rs` helper module. Each such file wraps its tests in a module named `e2e`, so libtest's test paths carry the `e2e` path segment and the `e2e::` substring filter selects them within each crate's own test invocation. Every e2e test also carries `#[ignore = "e2e tier: …; run via cargo test-e2e"]`, so a plain `cargo test` — the default unit+int gate — can never reach it. Selection is by libtest path substring, not by module path: the `.cargo/config.toml` aliases are `test-unit = "test tests::unit::"`, `test-int = "test tests::int::"`, and `test-e2e = "test e2e:: -- --ignored --test-threads=4"`. The `--test-threads=4` bound is required, not cosmetic: lbug reserves ~8 TiB of virtual address space per `Database`, and the heavy e2e crates (e.g. `splice_e2e`) exhaust the process address space at libtest's default parallelism (`Buffer manager exception: Mmap for size 8796093022208 failed`) while passing byte-identically at this bound. Non-test helpers/fixtures/builders live on the shared public library harness `apg::testutil` (`src/testutil.rs`, compiled unconditionally as a public module) or in the crate's `tests/common/mod.rs`, never inside a tier submodule and never stranded in a production module's inline `mod tests`; clippy `-D warnings` catches a stranded or unused helper. A tier may select zero tests.
